== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Self-Destruct Mechanism (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Self-Destruct Mechanism (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 24 January 2018). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>3116395864f243dd747b76c3f18810a2c845b8a6</code>.
